title: Distillation with Errors: Sparse Unbiased Backpropagation for Knowledge Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2611.27131v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Knowledge distillation (KD) trains a student to match a teacher's output distribution. However, full-vocabulary KD requires costly output-head backpropagation. To reduce this cost, we introduce Distillation with Errors (DWE). Our key insight is that minibatch training already approximates the training gradient, so per-position backpropagation does not need to be exact. DWE therefore exploits the zero-sum structure of logit gradients to construct sparse paired gradient estimates whose expectation matches the full-vocabulary gradient. It then uses geometry-aware pairing and stratified sampling to further reduce estimation variance. We prove that the estimator is unbiased and evaluate DWE's gradient estimation accuracy and training efficiency. At the same sampling budget, DWE reduces hidden-state and output-weight gradient MSE by 63.5% and 57.9%, respectively, compared with importance sampling. In off-policy KD, it achieves up to a $1.95\ti

translated_title: 带误差的蒸馏：面向知识蒸馏的稀疏无偏反向传播
translated_abstract: 知识蒸馏（KD）通过训练学生模型来匹配教师模型的输出分布。然而，全词表知识蒸馏需要对输出头进行代价高昂的反向传播。为降低这一成本，我们提出了带误差蒸馏（Distillation with Errors, DWE）。我们的关键洞察是：小批量训练本身已是对训练梯度的近似，因此逐位置的反向传播无需完全精确。为此，DWE 利用 logit 梯度的零和结构，构建稀疏的成对梯度估计，其期望与全词表梯度一致；随后通过几何感知配对和分层抽样进一步降低估计方差。我们证明了该估计器是无偏的，并评估了 DWE 的梯度估计精度与训练效率。在相同的抽样预算下，与重要性抽样相比，DWE 将隐藏状态和输出权重梯度的均方误差（MSE）分别降低了 63.5% 和 57.9%。在离策略（off-policy）知识蒸馏中，它实现了最高达 1.95 倍的加速提升。
tldr: 本文提出带误差蒸馏（DWE），利用 logit 梯度的零和结构构建稀疏成对的无偏梯度估计，并结合几何感知配对与分层抽样降低方差，从而大幅削减全词表知识蒸馏中输出头反向传播的计算成本。
en_tdlr: Distillation with Errors (DWE) exploits the zero-sum structure of logit gradients to build sparse, unbiased paired gradient estimates, further refined by geometry-aware pairing and stratified sampling, dramatically reducing the cost of full-vocabulary output-head backpropagation in knowledge distillation.
